intro: Gnoarn is an exiled gnome residing in Tinker Town within the dwarven mountain city of Ironforge. Displaced following the devastating fall of Gnomeregan, he assists his scattered people by directing adventurers to assist fellow gnomish engineers and survivors.

p: Like the majority of his brethren, Gnoarn was forced to flee the depths of Gnomeregan when troggs invaded and catastrophic radiation rendered the great subterranean metropolis uninhabitable. Taking refuge in Ironforge's Tinker Town under the hospitality of the Bronzebeard dwarves, Gnoarn spends his days keeping track of other survivors. He serves as an informal coordinator among the refugees, pointing capable travelers toward gnomes abroad who urgently require assistance, such as the stranded pilot Bingles Blastenheimer in Loch Modan or the ambitious engineer Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.
